input: Dzuwa linalowa m’chizimezime, n’kumawomba m’makwalala a mumzindawo. Anthu anathamangira m’tinjira tating’ono, mayendedwe awo akuyenda m’njira pamene makambitsirano anali kung’ung’udza. M’malesitilanti, mumamva kununkhira kwa khofi wopangidwa kumene wosakanikirana ndi fungo la zinthu zowotcha, kuchititsa anthu odutsa m’njira kuti aime kaye ndi kusangalala. Anthu oimba mumsewu anawonjezera nyimbo ndi kayimbidwe kake, ndipo kwakanthawi kochepa mzindawu unasandulika kukhala kamvekedwe kosangalatsa ka mawu ndi mitundu. Madzulo atafika, magetsi a mumzindawo anayamba kunyezimira, kuwalitsa kuvina kocholoŵana kwa moyo wa m'tauni komwe sikunayime.

Kudutsa malo aakulu a mapiri ndi nkhalango zowirira, mphepo inanong’oneza zinsinsi m’masambawo. Nyama zakuthengo zinkathamanga pansi pa dengalo, mayendedwe awo akuimba ballet mwakachetechete pansi pa maso akumwamba. Mtsinje wina unkayenda pang'onopang'ono m'derali, pamwamba pake kumasonyeza kuwala kwadzuwa ndipo kumapanga mitsinje yonyezimira yomwe imakondweretsa maso. Mbalame zinkaimba nyimbo zomwe zinkaoneka ngati zimafotokoza nkhani ya chilengedwe, nyimbo zotsatizana za moyo zomwe zinkamveka mwakachetechete. M’malo abata amenewa, nthawi inkaoneka ngati ikuchedwa, kupangitsa kuti nthaŵi yosinkhasinkha ndi yamtendere ichuluke.

Mkati mwa laibulale yaikuluyo munali mashelefu otambalala kosalekeza, odzaza ndi mabuku a nkhani iliyonse imene mungaiganizire. Kununkhira kwa mapepala okalamba ndi zomangira zachikopa kunadzaza mlengalenga, kukopa ofufuza a chidziwitso kuti afufuze m'mayiko osawerengeka. Owerenga ankakhala m'malo omasuka komanso pamatebulo akuluakulu, maso awo akuyang'ana masamba pamene maganizo awo akuyendayenda m'malingaliro, nkhani, ndi zomwe atulukira. Nthaŵi zina, phokoso la kutembenuza masamba kunkachititsa phokoso labata la maganizo. Kunja, dziko linapitiriza kuthamanga, koma mkati mwa makoma ameneŵa, chilengedwe chanzeru ndi kulingalira chinakula mu bata logwirizana.

Pamsika wodzaza anthu, ogulitsa anali kufuula zopereka zawo, kufunafuna chisamaliro pakati pa phokoso laphokoso. M'makhola munali zipatso zokometsera bwino, zonunkhiritsa, ndi nsalu zokongola, ndipo chilichonse chinali ndi mbiri yake komanso luso lake. Ogula amakangana pamitengo ndikusinthana nkhani, ndikupanga chithunzi chosangalatsa cha kulumikizana kwa anthu. Kununkhira kwa nyama yowotcha ndi makeke okoma kunali kumveka m’mwamba, kukopa anthu odutsa m’njira kuti asangalale. Pakati pa chipwirikiticho, panali kayimbidwe kakang'ono - kamvekedwe kamene kamapangitsa msika kukhala wamoyo komanso wowoneka bwino, umboni wa mzimu wokhazikika wamagulu.

Panyanja yaikulu, mafunde anagunda chombo cha ngalawayo, n’kutumiza madzi amchere m’mwamba. Ogwira ntchitowo ankayenda ndi cholinga, kukonza matanga ndikuyenda m'mlengalenga waukulu wabuluu, motsogozedwa ndi nyenyezi zokha komanso mwanzeru. M’chizimezimezi munali chinsalu chamitundumitundu kuyambira m’bandakucha kufika madzulo, kusonyeza kukongola kosalekeza kwa dziko. Mbalamezi zinkayenda mozungulira m’mwamba, kulira kwawo kumamveka m’madzi, zomwe zinkawonjezera phokoso la phokoso la nyanja. Ngakhale kuti nyanjayi inali patokha, anthu ankasangalala komanso akatulukira zinthu zina.

Mkati mwa paki ya mumzindawo munali anthu ambiri, kuseka kwa ana kunamveka pamene akusewera maswing ndi masiladi. Mabanja ankakondana pa mabulangete atafalikira pa udzu, akugawana nthano komanso kusangalala pamodzi pansi pa mthunzi wa mitengo italiitali. Othamanga ndi okwera njinga ankayenda m'njira zokhotakhota, zomwe zimapangitsa kuti pakhale bata lachirengedwe pakati pa moyo wa m'tauni. Abakha ndi akalulu ankayandama mokongola pamwamba pa dziwelo, zomwe zinachititsa kuti pakhale mtendere. M'kupita kwa tsiku, pakiyo inasanduka malo abata kumene anthu okhala mumzinda ankapeza mpumulo chifukwa chotanganidwa ndi ntchito zawo.

Pa nsonga za mapiriwo munapereka chithunzi chochititsa chidwi cha zigwa zozungulira ndi nsonga zakutali. Anthu okwera phiri anaunjikana mozungulira moto waung'ono, kugawana nthano za ulendo wawo ndi maloto amtsogolo. Mpweya unali wabwino komanso wopatsa mphamvu, wodzaza m'mapapu ndi mpweya wabwino komanso wotsitsimula. M'mapiri amiyalawa munali chipale chofewa chonyezimira, chonyezimira ndi kuwala kwa dzuwa, mosiyana ndi dziko lamdima ndi zomera zochepa zomwe zili pansi pake. Pamene mitambo inkayenda m’mbuyo, mithunzi inkayenda m’dera lonselo, kutsindika kukongola kolimba kwa malowo. Kuyimirira pamwamba pa dziko lapansi, wina adamva kulumikizana kwambiri ndi kukongola kosatha kwachilengedwe.

M’dera labata lakumidzi, mabanja anali kuchita ndandanda zawo mofatsa. Ana ankasewera mpira m’mphepete mwa misewu, kuseka kwawo kumalira m’mwamba pamene makolo ankangoyang’anitsitsa ali m’makhonde apafupi. Minda yophukira ndi chipwirikiti chamitundu - maluwa, tulips, ma daisies - zonse zimapikisana pakuwala kwa dzuwa ndi chidwi. Kununkhira kwa udzu wodulidwa kumene ndi maluwa ophuka kumene kunachititsa kuti pakhale malo ochititsa chidwi amene anaphimba maziko a nyumbayo. Madzulo anabweretsa kuwala kofewa kwa magetsi a mumsewu komanso kukhala ndi kupitiriza kwamtendere komwe nthawi zambiri sikudziwika koma kumayamikiridwa kwambiri.

Mabwinja akale ankasimba nkhani zachitukuko zomwe zinapita kalekale, makoma awo amiyala anali olimba koma okhalitsa. Mphesa ndi moss zinakwawira m'ming'alu, zomwe zimasonyeza momwe nthawi ndi chilengedwe chimakhalira kubwezeretsa chilengedwe cha anthu. Ofufuza ankayendayenda m'mabwalo ndi m'mabwalo, akuganizira za moyo womwe unalipo kale mkati mwa nyumbazi. Chetecho chinali chakuya, chododometsedwa ndi mkokomo wa mapazi ndi kulira kwakutali kwa mbalame. Dzuwa likamalowa kuseri kwa miyalayo, mithunzi inkatalika, kuchititsa chinsinsi komanso ulemu pamalopo. Icho chinali chikumbutso cha kukhalapo kosatha kwa mbiri yakale ndi nkhani zophatikizidwa mumwala uliwonse.

M'bwalo la ndege lomwe munali anthu ambiri, apaulendo ankadutsa mofulumira ali ndi chidwi ndi chidwi. Mawilo onyamula katundu ankagundana pamalo opukutidwa pamene nkhani za m'zinenero zambirimbiri zinkadzaza mlengalenga. Makanema a digito amawunikira nthawi yonyamuka ndi yofika, kuwongolera okwera omwe ali okhumudwa kapena okondwa kupita komwe akupita. Makapu a khofi ndi zokulunga zokhwasula-khwasula zinangoti mbwee m'makona ena, umboni wa chakudya cham'mawa chofulumira komanso kukonzekera komaliza. Pakati pa chipwirikiti chokonzekera, panali kumvetsetsa kogawana - mphindi yolumikizana pakati pa anthu osawadziwa yomangidwa ndi chikhumbo chofuna kufufuza, kubwerera, kapena kufunafuna zoyambira zatsopano. Nthawi zonse ulendo unali pafupi kupitirira.

Pachilumba chokongolachi, mafunde ang'onoang'ono anagunda magombe oyera amchenga, kuchititsa mpumulo ndi kusinkhasinkha. Mitengo ya kanjedza inkagwedezeka mwaulesi ndi mphepo ya m’nyanja, ndipo maonekedwe ake anali osiyana ndi thambo lowala. Anthu opita kunyanja ankawotchera dzuwa, kumanga nyumba za mchenga, ndi kusonkhanitsa zipolopolo za m’nyanja, n’kumasangalala ndi zinthu zosavuta zimene zinali ngati paradaiso. Pansi pa madzi, matanthwe okongola a coral munadzaza zamoyo za m'madzi zokongola, zomwe zimawonedwa m'madzi oyera omwe amawonetsa dziko lobisika lodabwitsa. Madzulo atatsala pang'ono kuyandikira, m'chizimezimecho munachita manyazi ndi mitundu ya lalanje ndi pinki, zomwe zinkasonyeza kutha kwa tsiku lina m'dera labatali. Kukongola kodekha kwa pachilumbachi kunapereka malo otetezeka kutali ndi phokoso la moyo wa tsiku ndi tsiku.

M'nyumba yamakono yamaofesi, ogwira ntchito ankagwirizana m'zipinda zochitira misonkhano zokhala ndi mipanda yagalasi ndi malo otseguka. Kung'ung'udza kwa makompyuta ndi kulira kwa mafoni kumapanga phokoso losalekeza, lodziwika ndi kudina kwa kiyibodi ndi mapepala akugwedeza. Zipinda zopumira zidapereka nthawi yopumula, ndi anzawo akugawana khofi komanso kucheza wamba. Zikwangwani zoyera ndi zowonera zimawonetsa ma chart, nthawi ya polojekiti, ndi malingaliro akusinthasintha, zonse zikugwira ntchito kuti zikwaniritse zolinga zofanana. Ngakhale kuti anali otanganidwa, panali malingaliro a cholinga ndi zatsopano zomwe zinatanthawuza kufunafuna kwamakono kwa kupita patsogolo ndi kupambana.

Malo okwerera masitima apamtunda omwe anali odzaza ndi anthu anali ngati njira yolumikizirana, pomwe nkhani zambiri zimadutsana. Apaulendo anathamangira kukakwera masitima awo, atanyamula zikwama ndi zikwama, chilichonse chili ndi kopita komanso maloto. Ogulitsa amagulitsa zokhwasula-khwasula ndi nyuzipepala pamodzi ndi zowerengera matikiti zomwe zimamveka ndi mawu ndi zilengezo. Pulatifomuyo inagwedezeka ndi chiyembekezo pamene injini zinali kubangula zamoyo, kusonyeza kunyamuka ndi ofika. M'malo osakhalitsa awa, nthawi zolumikizana ndi kutsanzikana zimasakanikirana, zomwe zimagwirizana ndi moyo watsiku ndi tsiku m'dziko lomwe silinasiye kuyenda.

Mkati mwa nkhalangoyi, kuwala kwadzuwa kunkadutsa m'masamba oundana kwambiri, n'kumachititsa nthaka yofewa. Zolengedwa zamitundumitundu zinkayenda mwakachetechete kudera lakwawo, chilichonse chimachita mbali yake m’dongosolo locholowana la zamoyo. Mpweyawo unali wodzaza ndi fungo la moss, pine, ndi dothi lachinyontho, zomwe zinapangitsa kuti anthu ayambe kukhazikika. Mtsinje wofatsa unadutsa m'mitengo, ndipo kamvekedwe kake kamamveka ngati mawu otonthoza a m'chipululumo. Malo opatulika osakhudzidwa ameneŵa anakhalabe umboni wa kupirira kwa chilengedwe ndi kukongola kosatha kwa malo osakhudzidwa.

M’khichini wotanganidwa kwambiri munali anthu ambiri pamene ophika ankaphika mbale zambirimbiri. Kumveka kong'ambika kuchokera ku skillet wosakanikirana ndi fungo la zitsamba, zonunkhira, ndi mkate wophikidwa kumene, kumapanga malo osangalatsa. Zosakanizazo zinadulidwa, kugwedezeka, ndi zokometsera mwatsatanetsatane, zomwe zimathandiza kuti zigwirizane bwino. Ogwira ntchito adayenda mosalekeza pakati pa masiteshoni, kugwirizanitsa kuti mbale iliyonse ifike pabwino. Alendo amadikirira chakudya chawo, chiyembekezo chokonzekera pamene zophikirazo zinasonkhana - mbale iliyonse ntchito yaluso yopangidwa kuti isangalatse mphamvu ndi kukhutitsa moyo.

M’nyumba yosungiramo zojambulajambula, makoma anali okongoletsedwa ndi zithunzithunzi zosiyanasiyana, ziboliboli, ndi zithunzi. Alendo ankayenda pang'onopang'ono kuchokera ku chidutswa kupita ku chidutswa, aliyense akuima kuti atanthauzira ndi kuyamikira masomphenya a ojambulawo. Kuwunikiraku kunawunikira mawonekedwe ndi tsatanetsatane, kupangitsa zojambulazo kukhala zamoyo. Kukambitsirana mwakachetechete za luso, kutengeka mtima, ndi tanthauzo zinawonjezera kuzama kwa chochitikacho. Malowa anali malo opatulika opangira zidziwitso ndi kulingalira, kumene mphamvu yowonetsera zithunzi inalimbikitsa malingaliro atsopano ndikulimbikitsa malingaliro.

M’maŵa m’maŵa pa dziwelo, nkhungu inanyamuka pang’onopang’ono kuchokera pamwamba pa madziwo, kumapanga mpweya wabwino. Abakha ankapalasa mwaulesi, n’kumasiya mafunde, pamene antchentche ankathamanga pamwamba pa mabango. M'bandakucha kunangoti mbwee ndi mbalame zofewa zomwe zikulandira tsikulo. Mitengo yozungulira ikuwonekera m'madzi abata, kuwirikiza kawiri malingaliro a bata. Mphindi yabata imeneyi inasonyeza kukongola kwachete kwa chilengedwe dziko lisanadzuke, kutikumbutsa za kayimbidwe kamtendere kamene kamakhala m’chilengedwe.

Nyali za m'bwalo la zisudzo zinazimiririka pamene chinsalucho chinkakwera, kusonyeza siteji ya masewero osaiŵalika. Osewera adalowa m'maudindo awo, akuphatikiza otchulidwa ndi chidwi komanso kukhudzika, ndikupangitsa nkhaniyo kukhala yamoyo. Omverawo adatengeka mtima, kuseka ndi kuwomba m'manja zomwe zikuwonetsa nthawi zowawa komanso kusintha kwakukulu. Nyimbo ndi kuunikira zinalimbikitsa kutengeka mtima ndi mlengalenga, kusandutsa danga kukhala malo amalingaliro ndi odabwitsa. Mchitidwewo utatha, kuwomba m'manja kunayamba, kukondwerera luso ndi khama zomwe zinapangitsa kuti ntchitoyo ikhale yosaiwalika kwa onse.

M’malo abata, nyumba zinaima m’mizere yaudongo, iliyonse ili ndi dimba lake lokhalamo maluŵa ndi zobiriwira. M'misewu munali anthu omwe ankawadziwa bwino komanso akugwedeza mutu mwaubwenzi, zomwe zinkasonyeza kuti anthu amakhala m'dera limodzi komanso anthu okhazikika. Ana ankasewera m’mabwalo pamene akuluakulu ankagwira ntchito zapakhomo kapena kukambirana pakhonde. Kumveka kofatsa kwa moyo watsiku ndi tsiku kunapanga maziko otonthoza, kutsindika kufunikira kwa nyumba ndi kulumikizana. Pamene madzulo kunagwa, kuwala kofewa kwa nyali za pakhonde kunalandirira usikuwo, kukhazikika mumayendedwe amtendere a moyo wakumidzi.

Mtsinje wa mapiriwo unkadutsa m’malo otsetsereka, ovutitsa anthu oyenda maulendo ataliatali ndiponso amiyala. Gawo lililonse linafunikira khama ndi kutsimikiza mtima, kudalitsidwa ndi malingaliro ochititsa chidwi pamsonkhanowo. Mpweya woziziritsa wa m’mapiri unalimbikitsa maganizo, pamene maluwa akuthengo ndi zomera zolimba zinamamatira m’ming’alu ya miyalayo. Nthaŵi zina, kulira kwa chiwombankhanga chapatali kapena kuona mbuzi ya kumapiri kunkakumbutsa oyendayenda za kukongola kwa kuthengo kozizinga. Kufika pachimake kunali mphindi yachipambano, umboni wa kupirira ndi mphamvu yochititsa mantha ya chilengedwe.

Msika wa mumzinda wakalewu unali piringupiringu, ndipo amalonda anali kukuwa ndi malonda awo ndipo makasitomala akungogula zinthu mwachisangalalo. Malo osungiramo katundu anadzaza ndi zinthu zopangidwa ndi manja, zokometsera, ndi nsalu, ndipo chilichonse chinali choimira chikhalidwe cha mzindawo. Kununkhira kwa zakudya zachilendo kunadzaza mpweya, kukopa anthu odutsa kuti atengeko zakudya zatsopano. Kumveka kwa nyimbo ndi kuvina kochokera kwa oimba apafupi kunachititsa kuti pakhale chisangalalo. Malo odzaza anthuwa sanali malo ochitirako malonda chabe; unali mphambano ya mbiri, miyambo, ndi kugwirizana kwa anthu.

Pansi pa thambo la usiku, motowo unkachita kuvina pankhope za apaulendo otopa. Kugawana nkhani ndi kuimba nyimbo, iwo anasangalala ndi chisangalalo chosavuta cha chiyanjano. Moto wonyezimirawo unapereka kutentha kwa mpweya wozizira, pamene nyenyezi pamwamba zinapereka chinsalu chakumwamba chodabwitsa kosatha. Kulira kwakutali kwa kadzidzi ndi kung'ung'udza pang'ono kwa masamba kunapangitsa kuti pakhale malo otonthoza. Panthawiyi, atazunguliridwa ndi chilengedwe ndi abwenzi, nthawi inkawoneka ngati ikuyimira, kutsindika kukopa kosatha kwa zochitika zakunja.

Msonkhano wamaphunzirowo unasonkhanitsa akatswiri ochokera padziko lonse lapansi kuti agawane malingaliro ndi kukambirana zatsopano. Okamba nkhani zazikulu adapereka maphunziro olimbikitsa, akuyambitsa mizere yatsopano ya mafunso ndi mgwirizano. Magawo otsatizana amalimbikitsa kukambirana, kulimbikitsa gulu la anthu ofuna kudziwa zambiri. Kusinthana kwa chidziwitso kunaphatikizidwa ndi zochitika zapaintaneti ndi zochitika zachikhalidwe, kupititsa patsogolo chidziwitso kupitilira maphunziro. Pamene msonkhano udatha, otenga nawo mbali adapititsa patsogolo malingaliro atsopano ndi maubwenzi omwe angakhalepo, zomwe zimalimbikitsa kupita patsogolo m'magawo awo.

Mumzindawu munagwa mvula pang'onopang'ono, zomwe zinachititsa kuti mawindo ndi madenga amveke bwino. Anthu oyenda pansi ankathamanga ndi maambulera, masitepe awo anali achangu koma osapupuluma, pamene maonekedwe awo ankanyezimira panjira yonyowayo. Fungo la nthaka yonyowa ndi mvula yachinyezi inalimbikitsa maganizo, kumapereka mphindi yokonzanso mkati mwa moyo wa m'tauni. Nyali za m'misewu zimapanga kuwala kwa golide, mosiyana ndi thambo lotuwa lozizira, zomwe zimawonjezera kutentha kwabwino pamalopo. Mpumulo ndi bata zinaloŵa m’malo mwa chipwirikiti choyambiriracho, pamene mzindawu unakumbatirana ndi mvula yotonthoza, kukumbutsa aliyense za mphamvu yodekha ya chilengedwe.

Kachisi wakaleyo anaima monga umboni wa luso la anthu ndi uzimu, makoma ake amiyala anathedwa nzeru ndi mphepo ndi nyengo ya zaka mazana ambiri. Ziboliboli zogoba ndi ziboliboli zogometsa kwambiri zinali zokongoletsa m’mbali zake zonse za m’mbali mwake, zonena za nkhani zongopeka za kudzipereka ndi nthano. Aulendo ndi alendo adapeza chitonthozo ndi chilimbikitso m'malo ake opanda phokoso, momwe munadzaza bata ndi ulemu. Kukhalapo kwa kachisi kunkagwirizanitsa zakale ndi zamakono, ndipo kunali chikumbutso chopatulika cha chikhalidwe cha anthu ndi kufunafuna tanthauzo. Pamene kuwala kwadzuwa kunkadutsa m'ming'alu ndi m'ming'alu, malowa anayamba kuona kuti ndi osakhalitsa.

Carnival yosangalatsayi inali yamitundumitundu, phokoso, ndi chisangalalo. Okwera anazungulira ndi kukwera, odzazidwa ndi kukuwa kwachisangalalo, pamene malo ochitira masewera amapereka mwayi wa mphotho ndi kuseka. Osewera ovala zovala ankasangalatsa khamu la anthu pogwiritsa ntchito maseŵero amatsenga, matsenga, ndi nyimbo, zomwe zinakopa chidwi cha mibadwo yonse. Kununkhira kwa maswiti a thonje, ma popcorn, ndi soseji wowotcha kunakopa opezekapo kuti asangalale. Pamene usiku unagwa, magetsi akuthwanima ndi nyimbo zinapanga malo amphamvu omwe amakondwerera chisangalalo, dera, ndi zosangalatsa zosavuta za moyo.

Pakona ya laibulale yabata, desiki imodzi idawunikiridwa ndi nyali, ndikuyitanitsa wowerenga kuti adzitaya m'buku. Masambawa anali ndi maiko azachisangalalo, chidziwitso, ndi malingaliro, khomo lililonse lofikira kumvetsetsa kwatsopano kapena kuthawa. Chete chozunguliracho chinalimbikitsa kuganizira ndi kulingalira, malo opatulika kuchokera kunja kwa chipwirikiti. Chapafupi, mashelefu olinganizidwa ndi mutu ndi wolemba anali ndi malingaliro ochuluka aumunthu ndi luso. Malo achidwi awa adapereka chitsanzo cha mphamvu yosatha yowerenga kuti alimbikitse, kuphunzitsa, ndi kusintha.

Munda wamphesawo unali m’mapiri osongoka, ndipo mipesa yake inali yolemera ndi mphesa zakupsa, ndipo zinali zokonzeka kukolola. Ogwira ntchito ankayenda mwadongosolo pakati pa mizere, kudulira ndi kutola, aliyense akusamalira nthaka mosamala ndi mwaluso. Dzuwa linapanga mthunzi wa golide pamalo obiriŵirawo, kugogomezera zobiriwira zobiriwira ndi zofiirira zozama. Mpweya unali wodzaza ndi fungo lokoma la zipatso ndi nthaka, zomwe zimasonyeza chiyambi cha moyo waulimi. Pamene nyengo yokolola inayandikira, chiyembekezo chinakula cha vinyo woti apangidwe kuchokera m’magulu amtengo wapatali ameneŵa.

Tawuniyo inali itakutidwa ndi chipale chofewa, inali malo abwino kwambiri m’nyengo yachisanu, ndipo madenga ake anali atakutidwa ndi zoyera ndipo tinthu tating’onoting’ono tomwe tinkangolendewera m’mbali mwake. M’misewu munali phee, mosokonekera chifukwa cha kugwa kwa chipale chofewa, kumapanga bata labata. Ana ankamanga anthu omenyana ndi chipale chofewa ndipo ankamenyana ndi chipale chofewa, ndipo kuseka kwawo kunali koopsa. Nyali zotentha zochokera m'nyumba zazing'ono ndi mashopu zinali zosiyana bwino ndi malo ozizira, zomwe zimadzutsa chisangalalo. Dera lonselo linkawoneka ngati lonyezimira ndi matsenga a nyengoyo, kupempha onse kuti alandire bata la m’nyengo yachisanu.

Mumzinda wadoko womwe unali wodzaza ndi anthu, zombo zonyamula katundu ndi mabwato osodza anafika padoko, milongoti yawo inkafika kumwamba. Ogwira ntchito m'madoko adayenda mwachangu, kutsitsa ndikutsitsa katundu omwe adalimbikitsa chuma chamzindawu ndikuulumikiza kudziko lonse lapansi. Malo ogulitsa misika m'mphepete mwa dokoli anali ndi nsomba zatsopano, zaluso zaluso, ndi zikumbutso kwa apaulendo ndi anthu am'deralo. Fungo la madzi amchere, nsomba za m’nyanja, ndi dizilo zosakanikirana mumpweya, zimasonyeza nyonga ya zamoyo za m’nyanja. Zombo zikayamba kuyenda kapena kufika, mzindawu unkayenda bwino chifukwa cha kuyenda, malonda, ndiponso kuyenda kwa nyanja.

Luso lophika buledi linadzaza ndi fungo lofunda, lochititsa chidwi lomwe linkakopa anthu odutsa mkatimo. Mkate wophikidwa kumene ndi makeke anaziika mwaluso m'mabokosi owonetsera, zotuwa zake zagolide ndi zigawo zake zosalimba zomwe zimakopa mphamvu. Ophika buledi ankalira mofuula pokanda mtanda ndi kupanga mikate, ndipo luso lawo linkaonekera m’mbali zonse. Makasitomala amasangalala ndi malo osangalatsa, amasangalala ndi khofi kapena tiyi, ndikugawana zokambirana pazakudya zophikidwa. Zopangira zophikirazi sizinangowonjezera thanzi komanso zimagwirizanitsa anthu kudzera mu miyambo, luso, komanso chisangalalo chosavuta cha chakudya chabwino.

M'kati mwa msonkhano wotanganidwa, amisiri ankagwira ntchito mwakhama pa ntchito zawo, chidutswa chilichonse chimasonyeza luso ndi chilakolako. Zipangizo kuyambira matabwa ndi zitsulo mpaka nsalu ndi dongo, ndi amisiri kusintha zinthu zosaphika kukhala luso ntchito. Phokoso la macheka, nyundo, ndi zida zoulutsira zida zinaphatikizana kukhala nyimbo zomveka bwino za chilengedwe. Alendo ankachita chidwi ndi lusoli, ndipo nthawi zambiri amalimbikitsidwa kuti azichita ntchito zawo zaluso. Msonkhanowo unali umboni wa luntha laumunthu ndi kukopa kosatha kwa zinthu zopangidwa ndi manja, zatanthauzo.

Pa chikondwerero champhamvu, zoyandama zokongoletsedwa ndi maluwa ndi nyali zimadutsa m'misewu, kukondwerera cholowa cha chikhalidwe ndi mzimu wa anthu. Ochita masewera ovala zovala ankavina ndi kusewera nyimbo, kukopa oonerera amisinkhu yonse. Malo ogulitsira zakudya anali ndi zakudya zokoma zachikhalidwe, zokometsera za mibadwo yakale. Mpweya unadzaza ndi chisangalalo, kuseka, ndi chisangalalo chotenga nawo mbali. Kutatsala pang’ono kugwa, zozimitsa moto zinayatsa mlengalenga, zomwe zinasonyeza mapeto a chochitika chosangalatsa, chosaiŵalika chimene chinasonkhanitsa anthu pamodzi m’chikondwerero.

Kumidzi yabata kunali minda ndi nkhalango, kumene nthawi inkaoneka ngati ikucheperachepera. Alimi ankasamalira mbewu ndi ziweto, zomwe zimachokera ku miyambo yakale. Midzi ing'onoing'ono inali pakati pa zobiriwira, ndi tinyumba tating'ono tokongola kwambiri. Phokoso lofatsa la chilengedwe - mbalame zikuimba, mphepo ikuwomba m'masamba, kulira kwa ng'ombe yakutali - kunapanga mawu otonthoza. Zinthu zokongolazi zinachititsa kuti anthu asamavutike m'tawuni, zomwe zinakumbutsa alendo za mtendere ndi kuphweka komwe kumapezeka m'chilengedwe.

M’chipatala chamakono, akatswiri a zaumoyo anagwira ntchito mosatopa kusamalira odwala, kudzipereka kwawo kumawonekera m’zochita zonse. Malo osabala anali malo ochitira zinthu, manesi ndi madotolo omwe amagwirizanitsa chithandizo ndi kuyang'anira zizindikiro zofunika. Ukadaulo wotsogola udathandizira kuzindikira ndi kuchira, kuphatikiza njira zachifundo ndi zatsopano. Odwala anapeza chitonthozo mu ukatswiri ndi kukoma mtima kwa ogwira ntchito, kudalira cholinga chawo kubwezeretsa thanzi ndi moyo. Malowa anali umboni wa kulimba mtima kwa anthu komanso kufunafuna machiritso kosalekeza.

Chipululucho chinatambalala kosatha, mtunda waukulu wa milu ya mchenga ndi mapiri amiyala pansi pa dzuwa lotentha. Zomera zamtundu wa Cacti ndi zolimba zidakhalabe ndi moyo m'malo ovutawa, kulimba kwawo kumapangitsa chidwi. Apaulendo ankayenda m’derali mosamala, podziwa kuopsa ndi kukongola kwake komwe kunali m’chipululuchi. Mirage inanyezimira chapatali, chinyengo chomwe chinkachita zamatsenga m'maso koma chimakulitsa chizindikiritso cha malo. Kulowa kwadzuwa kunasintha chipululucho kukhala chinsalu chofiira ndi malalanje oyaka moto, chochititsa chidwi chosakhalitsa cha mphamvu ya chilengedwe ndi kukongola kwake kwakukulu.

Kanyumba kabwino kamene kali pakati pa mitengo italiitali kanali kokhala malo opatulika akunja. Zoyaka moto zinang'ambika, kutulutsa kuwala komwe kumayenderana ndi kukongoletsa kwa rustic. Alendo ankacheza ndi mabuku kapena kugawana nkhani, akusangalala ndi bata la malo awo othawa kwawo. Kunja, chipale chofewa chinagwa pang'onopang'ono, ndikuphimba malo oyera, pamene mkati, kutentha ndi chitonthozo zinalamulira. Kukonzekera kwapamtima kumeneku kunaphatikizapo kubwerera ku kuphweka ndi chitonthozo chomwe chimapezeka mu kukumbatira kwa chilengedwe, kuthawa kwangwiro kwa kupuma ndi kutsitsimuka.

M’bwalo la zisudzo la mumzindamo, ochita zisudzo ankakonzekera kuseri kwa siteji, misempha yawo ndi chisangalalo chawo zinali zomveka. Oimbawo anaimba nyimbo zoimbira m’chipindamo pamene kuwomba m’manja ndi macheza. Pamene nsalu yotchinga inakwera, sitejiyo inasandulika kukhala dziko la sewero, nthabwala, kapena zomvetsa chisoni, zokopa omvera ndi kusonkhezera maganizo. Mgwirizano wa machitidwe - ochita zisudzo, oimba, ogwira ntchito pasiteji - adapanga luso lachidule lomwe linalipo panthawiyo. Pamene chochitika chomaliza chinatha ndi kuwomba m’manja, matsenga a zisudzo anakumbutsa aliyense za mphamvu ya nthano ndi kafotokozedwe ka anthu.

Bwalo la amonke lamtendere linali malo osinkhasinkha ndi abata. Amonke ankayenda mwakachetechete kupyola m’mabwalo, kusamalira minda ndi kukonzekera mapemphero a tsiku ndi tsiku. Fungo la zofukiza ndi maluŵa akuphuka zinawonjezera mkhalidwe wauzimu, kulimbikitsa kulingalira ndi bata. Alendo kapena okhalamo adatonthozedwa ndi kuphweka komanso kuwongolera kwa moyo wa amonke, momwe kulingalira ndi madera zimayenderana. Chifukwa chokhazikika mu miyambo yakale, malo opatulikawa ankapereka malo opatulika a moyo pakati pa chipwirikiti cha kunja.

Pamalo omanga otanganidwawo, ogwira ntchito anagwirizanitsa ntchito yomanga nyumba yatsopano, aliyense akumathandiza luso lake. Kuwomba kwachitsulo ndi kung'ung'udza kwa makina kunawonetsa kupita patsogolo, pomwe njira zachitetezo zimateteza aliyense. Zida zinafika mumtsinje wokhazikika - konkire, matabwa achitsulo, njerwa - gawo lililonse lofunikira kuti ntchitoyi ikhale yolimba. Akatswiri a zomangamanga ndi mainjiniya ankayang’anira ntchitoyo, kuonetsetsa kuti mapulaniwo akwaniritsidwa mokhulupirika. Malowa anali umboni wa zokhumba za anthu komanso kuyesayesa kogwirizana komwe kunafunikira kuti mapulaniwo akhale owona.

Matanthwe amphamvu a coral anali ndi zamoyo pansi pa madzi oyera a m'nyanja. Masukulu a nsomba zamitundumitundu ankadutsa pakati pa nthambi za korali, pamene akamba akunyanja okongola ankadutsa. Zinthu zachilengedwe za m'matanthwewa zinkathandiza kuti zamoyo zonse zisamayende bwino. Anthu oyenda m’madzi ndi osambira anafufuza paradaiso wapansi pamadzi ameneyu, akuchita chidwi ndi kukongola kwake ndi kusiyanasiyana kwake. Kuteteza malo osalimba ameneŵa kunali kofunika kwambiri kuti moyo wa m’madzi usungike kwa mibadwo yambiri.

M'kachisi wa Chibuda wabata, amonke ankachita miyambo ndi kusinkhasinkha, zomwe zinapangitsa kuti pakhale bata komanso maganizo auzimu. Fungo la zofukiza linkamveka m'mwamba pamene nyimbo zinkamveka mofatsa, zolondolera madokotala mkatimo. Ziboliboli ndi zifaniziro za milungu zinkapereka mfundo zofunika kwambiri za kupemphera ndi kusinkhasinkha, zomwe zinalimbikitsa kugwirizana ndi kulemekeza. Alendo ofunafuna mtendere ndi kuzindikira anatonthozedwa ndi bata losatha la kachisi. Malo opatulika oterowo ankakhala ngati malo ophunziriramo zamkati ndi kukulitsa chifundo.

Malo okongola otsetsereka otsetsereka a m'madziwa munadzaza ndi zochitika pamene anthu otsetsereka m'chipale chofewa komanso oyenda m'chipale chofewa ankayenda m'malo otsetsereka a chipale chofewa komanso tinjira ta m'mapiri. Mipando yonyamulira inanyamula alendo kupita kunsonga, kumapereka mawonekedwe owoneka bwino a malo okutidwa ndi chipale chofewa. Pambuyo pa tsiku lachisangalalo, alendo adasonkhana m'malo ogona abwino, akugawana nthano ndikuwotha ndi moto wobangula. Fungo la chokoleti yotentha ndi zakudya zopatsa thanzi zidadzaza mlengalenga, ndikuwonjezera chisangalalo chotsatira. Bwalo lamasewera m'nyengo yozizirali linali chikondwerero cha adrenaline, chilengedwe, ndi ubale, zomwe zidapanga zikumbukiro zomwe zidatenga nthawi yayitali chipale chofewa chitatha.

Mkati mwa labotale yotsogola, asayansi anachita zoyesera mosamalitsa, kudalira kulondola ndi ukatswiri. Zida zinkawala ndi magetsi owala pamene ankasanthula zitsanzo ndi kujambula deta, kufunafuna chidziwitso cha chilengedwe kapena kupita patsogolo kwaukadaulo. Mgwirizano ndi chidwi zimayendetsa ntchito yawo, zomwe nthawi zambiri zimatsogolera ku zopambana zomwe zingakhudze anthu bwino. Chilengedwecho chinali chophatikizika chadongosolo loyendetsedwa bwino ndi kufufuza kopanda malire, zomwe zikuphatikizapo mzimu waumunthu wotulukira zinthu zatsopano ndi zatsopano. Chotsatira chilichonse chinathandizira kufunafuna kwakukulu kwa kumvetsetsa ndi kupita patsogolo.

Malo osungiramo mabuku abwino kwambiri pa Main Street adakopa okonda mabuku ndi mawonekedwe ake okopa komanso mashelufu odzaza ndi mabuku. Owerenga adasakatula m'magulu osanjidwa bwino, kupeza olemba atsopano komanso zakale zosasinthika. Fungo la mapepala okalamba lidakwirira alendo, kukulitsa chisangalalo chakupeza nkhani ndi chidziwitso. Ogwira ntchito mwaubwenzi adapereka malingaliro, ndikuwonjezera kukhudza kwamunthu pazochitikazo. Iyi ndi malo ophunzirira mabuku olimbikitsa anthu, malingaliro, ndi maphunziro, kukulitsa mgwirizano pakati pa mawu ndi omwe amawakonda.

M'munda wamaluwa wokulirapo, zomera zobiriwira padziko lonse lapansi zidawonetsedwa m'magawo okonzedwa bwino. Njira zodutsamo m'mabedi amaluwa owoneka bwino, maiwe abata, ndi malo okhala ndi mithunzi, zomwe zimakopa kufufuza ndi bata. Olima dimba ankasamalira mwachikondi chomera chilichonse, kuonetsetsa kuti zamoyo zomwe zimapezeka kawirikawiri zimasungidwa komanso kukongola kwa malo. Alendo anachita chidwi ndi kusiyanasiyana kwa zomera, akumaphunzira za kugwirizana kwa chilengedwe ndi njira za ulimi wamaluwa. Mundawu udakhala malo opatulika a odziwa komanso obwera kumene, mawonekedwe amoyo odabwitsa achilengedwe komanso luntha laumunthu.

Pakiyi yosangalatsayi inali ndi zinthu zosangalatsa komanso zoziziritsa kukhosi ndi magudumu a Ferris, ndi masewera. Nyali zowala komanso nyimbo zosangalalira zinapangitsa kuti pakhale chisangalalo chomwe chimakopa makamu akutali ndi kutali. Ana ndi achikulire omwe adakumana ndi nthawi yachisangalalo ndi chisangalalo, kukumbukira kukumbukira pakati pa zosangalatsa ndi zopanda pake. Malo opangira ma Concession adapereka chilichonse kuyambira maswiti a thonje mpaka zokhwasula-khwasula, zomwe zinalimbikitsa ulendo wopitilira. Chiwonetserochi cha zosangalatsa ndi kuseka chinkakondwerera kuphweka ndi chisangalalo cha zosangalatsa zosasamala, kukumbutsa aliyense za chisangalalo chopezeka m'zochitika zomwe tagawana nawo.

M’nyumba yogona alendo yabata, alendo anasangalala ndi kuthaŵirako mwamtendere kuchoka ku zochitika za tsiku ndi tsiku. Kuwala kotentha komanso kuwala kotentha kumapangitsa kuti pakhale malo abwino, pomwe zakudya zopatsa thanzi zinkapereka chitonthozo komanso chakudya. Malo ozungulirawo anali ndi minda yozungulira komanso matabwa opanda phokoso, abwino kuyendamo ndi kusinkhasinkha. Kuchereza kwa mwini nyumbayo kunkachititsa kuti alendowo azisangalala. Malo awa osavuta komanso achilengedwe adapereka kupuma kotsitsimula, kulumikizanso apaulendo ndikuyenda pang'onopang'ono, kochita dala kwa moyo wakumidzi.

Nyumba yosungiramo zinthu zakale yochititsa chidwiyi inasonyeza zinthu zosiyanasiyana zaluso, mbiri yakale komanso zasayansi. Alendo adadutsa m'mawonedwe osanjidwa bwino, okhudzana ndi zinthu komanso mapanelo odziwitsa. Zomangamanga zokhazo zinali zaluso, zophatikiza zopanga zatsopano kuti zigwirizane ndi ziwonetsero mkati. Mapulogalamu a maphunziro ndi zochitika zapadera zinalimbikitsa chidwi ndi kuphunzira. Nyumba yosungiramo zinthu zakaleyi idakhala ngati mlatho wolumikiza zakale, zamakono, ndi zam'tsogolo, zolimbikitsa alendo kuti aziyamikira luso laumunthu ndi luntha pamaphunziro osiyanasiyana.

Paphiri labata, kanyumba kakang'ono kopemphereramo kanayang'ana malo ozungulira, malo ake otsetsereka akufika kumwamba. Aulendo ndi alendo anabwera kudzapeza chitonthozo, kupemphera, kapena kungosangalala ndi maonekedwe a panoramic. Makoma amwala ndi zamkati zosavuta zimasonyeza kudzichepetsa ndi kulemekeza, kulimbikitsa nthawi ya kusinkhasinkha ndi kugwirizana. Zochitikazo zinali chikumbutso cha kulondola kosatha kwaumunthu kwa kukula kwauzimu ndi kumvetsetsa. Dzuwa litalowa, nyumba yopemphereramo inawoneka ngati kuwala kwa chiyembekezo ndi mtendere pakati pa kukula kwa chilengedwe.
